tasks.title: Screenshot-led console and keyboard navigation
tasks.acceptance: Static build and keyboard/pointer browser checks pass; original media clearly distinguished from new studies.
tasks.note: Initial prototype deployed and source published.

tasks.title: Branch deployment implementation
tasks.acceptance: Develop/staging and main/production use isolated guarded targets and tests.
tasks.note: Workflow implemented; external activation tracked separately.

tasks.title: Mac onboarding and shared task coordination
tasks.acceptance: Clickable guide, own SSH keys, project tools, task claims and tests; friend verifies setup on her Mac.
tasks.note: Implementation by Copilot for tambo; real fresh-Mac acceptance still pending.

tasks.title: Activate and verify dev hosting and GitHub deployment
tasks.acceptance: Dev DNS/TLS, repository secrets and environment protection verified; staging Actions deployment succeeds before production gate activation.
tasks.note: User arranging Dreamhost subdomain and access. Do not duplicate hosting changes.

tasks.title: Agree restoration priorities and editorial direction together
tasks.acceptance: Both owners agree priority order, historic versus new content, initial launch scope and review responsibilities.
tasks.note: Good first collaborative task; no coding required.

tasks.title: Review source assets and publication permissions
tasks.acceptance: Home-only source inventory and rights/author credits reviewed; exact provenance updated; no private archive committed.
tasks.note: Can be led by a nontechnical collaborator. Broader archive remains out of scope.

tasks.title: Refine console fidelity and mobile controls
tasks.acceptance: Owner-approved screenshot comparison; touch, short screens, keyboard focus and Safari/Firefox verified.
tasks.note: Preserve display, keyboard bank and layered context menu.

tasks.title: Build reusable display-content player contract
tasks.acceptance: Typed content manifests support video, audio/visual, interactive and unavailable entries; load/error/end/cleanup states tested without backend runtime.
tasks.note: Foundation before adding playable media; no invented availability.

tasks.title: Restore reviewed music and video content
tasks.acceptance: Approved home-linked media sources, formats/credits, playback controls, user-gesture audio and mobile behavior verified; scope expansion approved if needed.
tasks.note: Choose a small owner-approved pilot first; legacy Flash never executed.

tasks.title: Expand AV Lab with intentional visual experiences
tasks.acceptance: Clearly labelled original/new studies with parameters, pointer/keyboard controls, reduced motion and performance checks.
tasks.note: Optional shape filtering should be designed with owners, not assumed to replace console.

tasks.title: Add browser-local favourites
tasks.acceptance: Save/remove, empty state, persistence, corrupt/unavailable storage tested; no account sync claim.

tasks.title: Restore historical Portfolio and Info copy
tasks.acceptance: Home-export text and case studies reviewed by owners, dates and historical context explicit, contact availability checked.
tasks.note: Suitable editorial ownership for the friend with agent help.

tasks.title: Choose and implement a modern game pilot
tasks.acceptance: Owners approve rules/source/rights and established engine; touch/keyboard, lifecycle and score tests pass; legacy code not executed.

tasks.title: Release accessibility, performance and security review
tasks.acceptance: Browser/device checks, content/rights, headers/404, media weight, no archive exposure, metadata/indexing and staging approval recorded.
tasks.note: Resolve current local preview dependency audit and review robots/indexing before launch.
